t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Choosing certain gnomes gives the red basket. You should select those. The baskets alternate however so you need to pick the right gnomes. They alternate when the points are low.

vb_textbox.text: Remember the groups. 1) Pink / Brown / Purple / Red. This group keeps the basket colour the same. If you get a high score keep it the same. Any other colour changes it. If you get low scores - change it.
